meaning:
1) to surround
1a) (Piel) to surround
1b) (Hiphil) to surround, encircle

elsewhere.note: They surrounded the Benjamites, chased them, and trod them down at their resting place, as far as near Gibeah toward the sunrise.
“Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.
Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.
The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails; for the wicked surround the righteous; therefore justice comes out perverted.
